description:
Developed for Cycling Without Age. Perfect for sharing the ride.

The Christiania Model T — also known as the Taxi or Trishaw — was originally created for the wonderful Cycling Without Age movement in Denmark. Designed to carry two adult passengers seated side by side, it makes cycling accessible for people of all ages and abilities. From retirement homes and senior centers to tour operators, hotels, and theme parks, the Model T opens the outdoors to everyone.

Built for InclusionThe Model T is more than a cargo trike — it’s a people mover. It helps seniors, those with limited mobility, and families share the joy of cycling together. Whether on a seaside promenade, a city park path, or a neighborhood ride, the Model T keeps everyone connected to fresh air and sunshine.

The Christiania Model T combines Danish craftsmanship with inclusive design. Built tough enough for daily service yet welcoming and comfortable for passengers, it’s the trusted choice for organizations, businesses, and families who want to bring people together on three wheels.

Equipped with the Shimano Steps EP600-CRG mid-drive motor (85Nm)

630Wh downtube battery with 5 levels of pedal assist

LCD center display with battery level, headlight control, twist throttle, and walk assist
